proposal.observation: detected_lines.png shows all 10 vertical ring boundaries (magenta, pitch ~363 px) so ring_count_error=0, but the oblique line yield is very low: only ~6 positive-slope (red) and ~6 negative-slope (green) segments over a 10-ring x ~4800 px map, while blue horizontal fallback segments are far more numerous. initial_prompt_points.png confirms this: of the 10 prompt centres only 3 come from oblique intersections (2 positive_slope, 1 negative_slope); 4 are 'midpoint' fallbacks from horizontal lines and 3 are 'assume' fallbacks. Joints in the binarised outlier map appear as faint dotted V-marks and sparse dotted verticals rather than continuous lines. depth_map_viridis.png shows a mostly filled lining with holes confined to the top structure band and the bottom curved fixtures (depth_nan_ratio 0.223, close to the dev reference 0.208), so depth holes are not the dominant upstream issue. segmentation_results.png shows a plausible K/B/A block layout per ring, but correspondence_f1@15 is only 0.315 with chamfer 76 px and boundary_explained_edge 0.54, consistent with prompt centres that are vertically misplaced relative to the true joint pattern.
proposal.rule: d7 (stage_4_detection): m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered -> f_missing_lines. Precondition per r_relax_hough: rule out f_depth_holes (nan ratio moderate, lining core intact -> not dominant) and f_joint_oversmoothed (joints faint but present as dotted marks -> partial contributor, addressed mildly at stage 3 rather than stage 1/2). Inter-stage chain: f_missing_lines -> unstable prompt centres -> stage_5 f_crop_offset -> low correspondence_f1@15.
proposal.failure_mode: f_missing_lines (too few oblique lines; prompt centres derived mainly from horizontal 'midpoint' and 'assume' fallbacks), with upstream contribution from f_joint_oversmoothed.
proposal.rationale: Stage 1 is locked (residual 9.10 cm below gate) so unfolding is untouched. Denoising is untouched because depth_nan_ratio is near the dev reference and the tight-radial-band degrade example (g000, mask_r 3.77/3.81 -> nan 0.93) shows how fragile that band is. The overlay follows r_relax_hough and mirrors the direction of the only improving worked example (s021: hough_threshold_oblique 27, maxLineGap_oblique 74, hough_threshold_horizontal 60, maxLineGap_horizontal 28, pattern_tolerance 11, curvature_threshold 0.00037; correspondence_f1@15 0.446->0.460, nan 0.208->0.197), whereas the degrade example (g000) used a high oblique threshold (63) with a low horizontal threshold (25) and short oblique gap (37). Concretely: lower the oblique Hough accumulator threshold and lengthen the oblique maxLineGap so the dotted V-shaped joint marks link into 5-10 deg segments; raise the horizontal Hough threshold so horizontal fallback fires less often and the oblique intersections take priority; slightly lower binary_threshold so faint joint pixels survive binarisation; nudge pattern_tolerance up so the K/AB distance check accepts the recovered oblique intersections; lower curvature_threshold modestly to densify the surface and shrink small voids that break joint continuity (analogy to s021's nan reduction). All values are inside configs/bounds/complex.json. This is a joint overlay; no per-parameter causal attribution is claimed.
